facts.1: records which process held each local TCP port over time
facts.2: answers what was on a port earlier, after the process has exited
facts.4: portlog start runs a background recorder; portlog stop stops it
facts.5: portlog who 3000 lists every process that held port 3000, newest first
facts.6: --since 2h limits who to the last two hours
facts.7: portlog free 3000 stops the current holder after confirmation; -y skips it
facts.10: never records command-line arguments, because they can hold secrets

agentOnly.11: polls lsof every 2 s on macOS; reads /proc/net/tcp on Linux
agentOnly.12: SQLite store in WAL mode, 500 ms busy timeout
